title: Prove all-r adapted-Hessian support at every affine mean
statement: For EVERY k=(2r+1)/3>1/3, upper-triangular A and symmetric H, put L_k=diag(2k,-(3k+1)),ell=3k-1,n=k+1,m=3k+1 and Lambda_k(A)=2det A+(ell/m)[k|A1|^2-|A2|^2+(3n/2)det A]. The ORIGINAL J_k obeys J_k(A+L_kH)-J_k(A)-DJ_k(A):L_kH-Lambda_k(A)det(L_kH)>0 for H!=0, with positive per-k c_k times |A|^2|L_kH|^2+|L_kH|^4. Constant LEFT QR transfers this to EVERY affine A with L_(k,A)=R L_k. Consequently strict all-amplitude scalar-Hessian Jensen holds on any rectangular torus for W2,4 potentials and compact scalar potentials. The exact full four-by-four augmented affine matrix is positive by all Sylvester minors: complete diagonal Gram, nonnegative positive-T coefficients, signed T2 grouped tail and FOUR-term T1 cubic/discriminant certificate with coordinate charts. The unsuccessful old three-term allocation is excluded; its historical record is retained. Per-k reserve is uniform on compact k intervals, not at endpoints or on the whole half-line. No arbitrary vector-gradient or variable-frame conclusion.
